title_en: What have you been up to?
goal_ko: 요즘 하는 일을 묻고, 계속해 온 일과 기간을 말하기
offer_ko: ‘요즘 어떻게 지내요?’ 표현을 잠깐 익혀 볼까요?

expressions.en: What have you been up to?

ok: What have you been up to?
what have you been doing lately

expressions.pattern: ^(?:ive been|i have been)(?: really)? (?<x>[a-z]+ing(?: [a-z]+){0,6}?)(?: (?:lately|recently|these days|a lot))?$
expressions.accept_note: ‘I’m learning…’(현재진행)·‘I’ve been busy…’는 뜻 전달(부분). ‘I been …’은 불인정.

ok: I’ve been learning to cook lately.
I have been working a lot
ive been reading books these days
How long have you been learning it?
how long have you been doing yoga

scene.en: Nubi! Long time no see. What have you been up to?
I’ve been learning to cook lately.
Wow! How long have you been cooking?
About two months. What have you been up to?
I’ve been running in the mornings.
Nice! How long have you been running?

story_notice_ko: 이제 진짜 내 이야기예요. 떠오르지 않으면 장면 속 일(learning to cook)로 해도 돼요.

story.en: So, what have you been up to lately?
story.screen_hint_ko: 요즘 하는 일을 문장으로: I’ve been ___ lately. (working a lot, reading books)

story.en: How long have you been doing that?
story.screen_hint_ko: 얼마나 됐는지: For ___. (two weeks, a year)

ask_me.screen_hint_ko: 토리에게 물어봐요: What have you been up to?

ask_me.en: I’ve been running in the mornings.
ask_me.screen_hint_ko: 얼마나 됐는지 물어봐요: How long have you been running?

branches.say: For about a year! It feels great.

privacy_ko: 요즘 하는 일은 이 연습에만 쓰고 기억에 남기지 않아요. 일·건강의 힘든 이야기는 공통 민감 규칙.
